notes.title: Team Editor added in v0.6
notes.notes: [p]An editor has now been added in v0.6 to allow you to add new teams or make a copy of existing team data so you can make changes and override it.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45305681/cc35830c0a35b42ca94a212c5e4f6ade3f36db18.png"][/img][/p][p]This means you can change the names of players to reflect real names or even create entirely new teams from any year from 1960 to 202x such as Premier League, La Liga or you local pub teams.[/p][p][/p][p]If you create something special then why not upload it to the Steam Workshop.[/p][p]Check out the guide for more details.[/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3537149438"]GUIDE[/url][/p][p][/p][p]If you have any queries then please head over the the Discussions are.[/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3346740/discussions/"]DISCUSSIONS[/url][/p]

notes.title: Foul Referee!
notes.notes:
V0.5 is here featuring the following:
[list]
[*] Referees with varying levels of harshness
[*] Yellow/Red Cards
[*] Injuries
[*] Suspensions and injuries causing players to miss games in tournaments
[*] AI substitutions
[/list]

These features can be turned off in the settings if you prefer a good dirty slide tackle to go unpunished.

Most notable bug fix:
[*] Euro tournament bug fix when getting in to knockout stages causes issue.

notes.title: Fouls, Free Kicks and Penalties
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45305681/c81d45031f83c0b2da105acab126bf5ce2b123b0.gif[/img]

At last the first update is here and it brings fouls, free kicks and penalties along with a number of bug fixes. For the moment I try to establish when a foul has been committed by a slide tackle (ie the ball has not been won cleanly and the player wasn't wiped-out first) and then a referee pop-up will appear and a free-kick or penalty is awarded.

Fouls can be turned off in the settings menu if you just want a free for all.

[b]Major Bug fix: [/b]
Correct teams going through in cup competition when playing a 4 group to 8 team knock-out such as Euro 96.

[b]Next Update[/b]
In the next update I will be introducing red & yellow cards which will impact cup & league tournaments that bit more and also add a referee style so that different refs may be more lenient than others and show this in the pre-match screen so you can tailor your playstyle accordingly.

notes.title: Retro Soccer is launching on March 17, 2025!
notes.notes:
Retro Soccer will launch on PC on March 17, 2025.

From this initial Early Access release you get to compete in World Cups and Euros between 1986 and 1996 with 90's style game-play for quick slick passing action, plenty of dirty slide tackles, rasping curling shots and the odd diving header thrown in for good measure.

Although this is EA the majority of the game-play elements are in place.

The first update which I am actively working on now will include Fouls, Free Kicks, Penalties, Injuries, and Yellow & Red cards which can impact your tactics throughout a cup / league campaign.

I'm listening to feedback on the forums so if you have any suggestions please drop by and leave a comment.

notes.title: Demo v0.1.26 released
notes.notes:
]A lot of work has gone on behind the scenes to get the first FULL release of Retro Soccer ready with all teams and players database for World Cups and Euros between 86 and 96 now complete.

As part of the on going development I noticed a number of UI bugs which I fixed and also had a request to speed up the game-play to bring it more in line with the speed found in the classic Sensible Soccer for the Amiga.

[b]So included in the new Demo version...[/b]
I have updated the Demo to include all bug fixes for UI and game-play along with the game-play speed increase. If its a little too much for you it can always be toned-down in the Settings menu.

Goal keeper intelligence has also been improved although this is an on going process and more work will be done in this area.

[b]What's Next?[/b]
With the team & player database now out of the way I can get back to focusing on the game-play which includes introducing fouls, freekicks, penalties, injuries and red / yellow cards.

[b]Known Issues[/b]
The keeper sometimes looks like he plucks the ball out of the air when its a bit too far away.
I once saw the ball go out of play near the goal but it didn't register and the ball was brought back in to play and a goal scored - VAR are looking in to it.

If you notice any bugs or have any feedback then please head over to the forums and let me know.

Thanks!
